# Identify the season for Dallas Cowboys in 1975
cowboys_1975_season = df.loc[df['Team'] == 'Dallas Cowboys', 'Season'].values[0]

# Find all seasons after 1975
later_seasons = df[df['Season'] > 1975]

# Sort by Season to get the next champion in order
later_seasons_sorted = later_seasons.sort_values('Season')

# Get the first row after sorting (i.e., the next NFC champion)
next_champion_row = later_seasons_sorted.iloc[0]

# Extract the team name
answer = next_champion_row['Team']
